items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I mean certainly that happened in Lunceford’s band a lot where the sections would just rehearse their parts

ctx.x: Because sometimes you read about the fact that maybe they all weren’t great readers, but they, boy, they did that stuff so well.

Well and they also had section rehearsals I’m sure they sat down and the sections just rehearsed. I mean certainly that happened in Lunceford’s band a lot where the sections would just rehearse their parts and then when they came together, boom, they’re ready to roll. So exactly. They wanted to make sure they got it right and made it sound good.
Yeah. There was a — I was doing a little poking around about you.
